facts.rationale: Returns immediately when x221F_b3 is set. Otherwise, a nonzero index requests effect 0x43F, followed by ftCo_800D331C and the inline helper. That helper conditionally calls ft_800880D8 and clears x2004, sets three flags, and invokes the direct Sleep initializer. The cleanup callee invokes death callbacks and handles attached items. The proposed name distinguishes this preparation path without claiming that the effect is unconditional or that the routine is specific to one fighter kind.
